# nninitStartup (main+0x260bb10) asks for ((total - used) & ~0x1fffff) - 0xaf200000: with this pool and the default 64 MB used, 0x18ce00000 (6.2 GiB). The Switch 1 pool would give it 418 MiB against about 5.9 GiB of HeapDef heaps

# 2026-11-05: the game keeps 0xaf200000 (2.74 GiB) of the pool for its virtual-address heaps (main+0x260bb10); without the limit UsedMem never counted the alias pages and it mapped 6 GB in Hyrule Field, then a model heap ran out (null MatBlock pool, crash). On Horizon maps past the pool fail and the game evicts

# 256 MB in front + 16 GB alias region (Splatoon Raiders' and Fortune's Weave's) + 256 MB stacks + 8 GB heap region (Mario Kart World's). A Mac-only layout, sized for room: the region check measures the alias use
# agl's conditional clear: SetRenderEnableConditional at main+0x23e378, ClearColor at main+0x23e3a0, the sequence Donkey Kong Bananza's note describes; without the key games with it come out black
# the game has dynamic resolution that reads a GPU load, as Donkey Kong Bananza; DM_NVN_GPU_TS=submission undoes this at run time
# tex_flush_upload and tex_dirty_upload stay off: Tex/*.bntx.zs and no .txtg, as Bananza. Add both as on if the scene comes out black or the terrain magenta (a host rebuild only)
# inputs of every shader's cache key: do not change these two after the first shader build
